description: This file defines enums, data structures, and classes for RFC parameter handling, including an interface class RfcApiImpl and a wrapper class RfcApi, along with associated function pointers.

classes.name: RfcApiImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class defining interface for RFC parameter get/set operations.

classes.name: RfcApi
classes.description: Wrapper class providing static methods and managing a singleton implementation of RfcApiImpl.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Static method to set the implementation instance for RfcApi.

methods.name: getRFCParameter
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an RFC parameter.

methods.name: setRFCParameter
methods.description: Static method to set an RFC parameter.

methods.name: getRFCErrorString
methods.description: Static method to get error string corresponding to WDMP_STATUS code.
